craft_notes: Sthāyin: living-free joy (jīvanmukta seal). Sanskrit first: clearance + even-amid + fear-gone → L4 sets clearance line 1, life line 2. Rows: row 1 (life-last — yogī closes as life closes). Rupture: dash after strife — clearance done, life stated. Close: end-weight on life (living crowned). Minimal pass: dash for L3 comma. Read aloud: shed, still, fearless. Rejected: 'while alive' gloss — killed: in life kept (jīvan); 'brave' for vigatabhaya — killed: fear-gone is absence, brave is virtue.

lines: Delusion shed — born of real-and-unreal strife —
he lives among men still, fearless: yogi in life.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vigalitasadasadvikalpasadasadbhramajanitamohamuktātmā / jīvann api janamadhye vigatabhayaḥ sarvadā yogī

reads_against.argmap: Delusion-freed, living amid people, fear gone always — the yogin lives free.
c1_essence: Delusion-freed, living amid people, fear gone: yogin free.
